description: This Java class 'Output' provides helper methods for writing formatted text, characters, and StringBuilder content to a character stream through a Writer instance. It encapsulates common output operations used by other classes in the 'com.android.mkstubs.sourcer' package.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: A utility class for writing formatted text, characters, and StringBuilder instances to a specified Writer.

methods.name: Output
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a Writer object for output operations.

methods.name: write (String, Object...)
methods.description: Writes a formatted string to the underlying Writer, handling IOExceptions internally by throwing a RuntimeException.

methods.name: write (char)
methods.description: Writes a single character to the underlying Writer.

methods.name: write (StringBuilder)
methods.description: Writes the string representation of a StringBuilder to the underlying Writer.
